Select IC50 activity records for the human single-protein target B-RAF (CHEMBL5145) with publication provenance.

Join path: activities (on assay_id) -> assays -> target_dictionary (filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5145'), activities -> compound_records (on record_id) -> molecule_dictionary (on molregno), compound_records -> docs (on doc_id), molecule_dictionary -> compound_structures (INNER JOIN, require non-null canonical_smiles).

Filter: activities.standard_type = 'IC50', target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5145', compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL.

Return columns (no deduplication — keep every qualifying activity row):
- compound_chembl_id (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id)
- canonical_smiles
- compound_key (compound_records.compound_key)
- pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fallback to docs.doi)
- assay_description (assays.description)
- standard_type
- standard_relation
- standard_value
- standard_units
- activity_comment
- target_chembl_id (target_dictionary.chembl_id)
- target_name (target_dictionary.pref_name)
- target_organism (target_dictionary.organism)

Sort by: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
